calculators.name: Injection Molding - Cycle Time
calculators.description: Injection cycle time = (Fill + Pack + Cooling + Mold open/close) x Cycle Time Adjustment Factor (formula registry F-08, ASSUMED). Cooling is the Menges plate-cooling equation, t = s^2 / (pi^2 alpha) x ln((4/pi)(Tm - Tw)/(Te - Tw)), alpha = k / (rho cp) (F-04, ASSUMED: memory/ holds no cooling formula). Fill = shot melt volume / the press injection rate x the injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors for cavities and gates (F-05, VALIDATED). Pack = 35 % of cooling with a 2 s floor, the Menges gate-freeze rule (F-06, ASSUMED: the reference holds no hold time). Mold open/close = the press Euromap 6 dry cycle (F-07, VALIDATED). Not modelled, because the reference has no formula or press data: ejector travel, plasticizing, part and material handling, slides and lifters. Rounded as the engine does: cooling and pack to 0.1 s, fill and the total to 0.01 s.

source.engine: shotMeltVolumeMm3 (part volume x cavities + runner, at melt density)

source.lookup: injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors.Adjustment Factor where Attribute = Cavities Per Mold and Number >= cavities per mold (first bracket)
injectionTimeAdjustmentFactors.Adjustment Factor where Attribute = Gates Per Cavity and Number >= gates per cavity (first bracket)

source.machine: time.dryCycleTimeS (Euromap 6: mold open and close, no material)

fields.name: Mold Wall Temperature
fields.formula: {Mold Temperature} + {Mold Temperature Increase}

fields.name: Thermal Diffusivity
fields.formula: {Thermal Conductivity of Melt} / ({Melt Density} * {Specific Heat of Melt} * 1000) * 1000000

fields.name: Cooling Time
fields.formula: floor({Nominal Wall Thickness} * {Nominal Wall Thickness} / (pi * pi * {Thermal Diffusivity}) * LN(4 / pi * ({Melt Temperature} - {Mold Wall Temperature}) / ({Ejection Temperature} - {Mold Wall Temperature})) * 10 + 0.5) / 10

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: floor({Shot Melt Volume} / {Press Injection Rate} * {Fill Factor for Cavities} * {Fill Factor for Gates} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

fields.name: Pack Time
fields.formula: max({Pack Time Minimum}, floor({Cooling Time} * {Pack to Cooling Ratio} * 10 + 0.5) / 10)

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: floor(({Fill Time} + {Pack Time} + {Cooling Time} + {Press Dry Cycle Time}) * {Cycle Time Adjustment Factor} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

calculators.name: Injection Molding - LSR Cycle Time
calculators.description: Liquid silicone rubber cures instead of cooling: Cure Time = A x exp(Ea/R / (T + 273.15)) x wall (Arrhenius, literature constants of Ossipov et al., Polymer Engineering 2002, at a 180 C default mold temperature: F-09, ASSUMED for every LSR grade); no pack phase; Cycle Time = (Fill + Cure + Mold open/close) x Cycle Time Adjustment Factor. The engine uses this variant for LSR materials; no catalog operation maps to it.

fields.name: Cure Time
fields.formula: floor({LSR Pre-exponential Factor} * exp({LSR Activation Energy over R} / ({LSR Mold Temperature} + {Kelvin Offset})) * {Nominal Wall Thickness} * 10 + 0.5) / 10

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: floor({Shot Melt Volume} / {Press Injection Rate} * {Fill Factor for Cavities} * {Fill Factor for Gates} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: floor(({Fill Time} + {Cure Time} + {Press Dry Cycle Time}) * {Cycle Time Adjustment Factor} * 100 + 0.5) / 100

calculators.name: Compression Molding - Cycle Time
calculators.description: Compression cycle = press open/close time (the staged press_cycle_time_s: platen close + open motion) + the material's cure time. Not modelled, because the reference holds no formula: charging, preheat, flash trimming and part handling. The cycle is understated by those until validated formulas are supplied; a grade with no cure time on file contributes none (said in the trace).

source.machine: press_cycle_time_s (the machine's platen close + open motion time)

source.material: cureTimeMin (raw_materials.cure_time_min; absent for a grade with none on file: seeded 0 and said in the trace, the cycle is then understated)

fields.name: Cure Time
fields.formula: {Material Cure Time} * 60

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: {Press Open/Close Time} + {Cure Time}

calculators.name: Reaction Injection Molding - Cycle Time
calculators.description: RIM cycle = machine dry cycle + fill + cure. Dry cycle = the machine's mold open/close with no material (staged as press_cycle_time_s). Fill Time = Total Shot Volume / Machine Injection Rate (formula registry F-19, ASSUMED: the staged rate over the shot volume is the approved simplification; the reference states no RIM fill formula), with Total Shot Volume = Part Volume x Cavities per Mold in mm3 and the rate in mm3/s, so the result is in seconds. Cure Time = the material's cure or reaction time. Cycle Time = (Dry cycle + Fill + Cure) / Cavities per Mold, per part; the RIM engine prices one part per press cycle (1 cavity). Not modelled, because the reference has no volume or formula: runner and sprue volume, mix-head purge, viscosity, flow resistance, the injection profile, and part handling. A missing or invalid part volume or injection rate makes the cycle a named gap, never a default.

source.engine: the RIM engine prices one part per press cycle: 1

source.material: cureTimeMin (raw_materials.cure_time_min; absent for a grade with none on file: seeded 0 and said in the trace, the cycle is then understated)

fields.name: Total Shot Volume
fields.formula: {Part Volume} * {Cavities per Mold}

fields.name: Fill Time
fields.formula: {Total Shot Volume} / {Machine Injection Rate}

fields.name: Cure Time
fields.formula: {Material Cure Time} * 60

fields.name: Cycle Time
fields.formula: ({Machine Dry Cycle Time} + {Fill Time} + {Cure Time}) / {Cavities per Mold}
